subject: Taxes
title: The Power of Default Options
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Power of Default Options.

hook.text: When pension contributions are opt-out instead of opt-in, enrollment jumps from 40% to 90%. Defaults shape decisions.

buildup.text: A default option is what happens if you do nothing.

discovery.text: Pre-filled tax returns in Sweden and Estonia use this principle. The government fills in the form; you just confirm.

twist.text: The US could pre-fill returns for 60% of taxpayers.

climax.text: Default settings are the most powerful nudge in behavioral science.

punchline.text: Make paying easy and it becomes the default. Compliance is a design choice.

quiz.question: Why do pre-filled tax returns improve compliance?
options: They make compliance the default action, reducing effort
